text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text: Mm... Mgh! This curry's so delicious! Oh man... Gulp, gulp. Hwaaah! Phew! Thanks! I needed that!

text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for all the trouble!
But I'm right as
rain now, thanks to your help!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it. However... it was a
shock that you collapsed from
hunger.
Why didn't you eat something before
things got so dire?

text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
I got so into my research that I
kind of forgot to eat.
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Research? What kind of research?!

text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I thought you'd never ask! As a
matter of fact...

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I'm working on creating a brand-new
model of aircraft!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A new airplane? For real?! Wow, that's
awesome! I wanna see it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I have piloting skills, which
means... airplanes already exist,
don't
they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it,
we saw some flying on the way here. The
wings were made of
wood, kind of like a toy airplane. Are you
saying those are the old models?

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Exactly.
They can only fly for short periods
of time. But what I'm
working on is a steel
construction that can fly higher, faster,
and farther!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Steel? Can something like that truly fly?
The engines of this world run
on steam,
don't they? The sheer burden placed on
them would—

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: Trust me, this bird will fly! I saw the proof with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
The steel airplane got so close to flying
over the precarious mountains surrounding
the town! My eyes were glued to the sky,

hoping to see that crucial moment!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I ran after it until it landed!
As soon as that
hatch was open, I begged
the pilot to take
me under his wing as an apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that plane...
I realized for the
very first time that I had no
idea what lies
beyond those mountains.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
With automobiles and trains, transporting
goods and people is a
cinch. Still, there
are no roads or rails that go through the
mountains.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
No one knows what lies beyond... Well, I
want to find out!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
And I want to show everyone the new
world out there too! I want them to dream
again!
That's why I'm trying to fly over the
mountains with my new airplane!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Uwaaaaugh! That's soooo relatable! I totally get yooou!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You want to chase your dream and share it
with everybody! That's so
beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And you worked so hard you keeled over
from hunger! I'm. So.
MOVED! I can't even
stand iiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Your dream will definitely come true, 'cause we've got your back! Right, guys?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon. Doesn't seeing her put her
heart and soul into this make
you want to
help out?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she worked herself to the point of
collapsing from hunger. She'll
need our
support if she's to avoid a repeat of the
incident.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Listen, this is all a story in a game—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're not wrong! But this is
probably a mission! Which means,
from a
gameplay perspective, we need to help
her to clear it, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...So you're saying we ought to cooperate with her? Sigh... Fine.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I'll help out too! I wanna
build an airplane and fly
allll the way over
the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided. With the five of us
helping, we'll get you on a
regular
schedule of meals and sleep to
supplement your research.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: Y-you'd really do that... for me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We want you to achieve your dream!
Please, let us help you
build your airplane!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. The mission screen's been updated.
"Make the Researcher's
Dream Come
True." Teio was right.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! So this is where the magic
happens!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! And this is the plane you're in
the middle of making?! There
are no seats!
I can see all the plane's insides! Cooool!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Turbo!
Don't just touch things willy-nilly!
Ahh!
Th-that was a close call...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why's nobody else here? What
about that pilot you were
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You said you chased after the airplane's
creator so you could become
his
apprentice, right?

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Actually,
he retired... So it's just me
now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're doing all this by yourself?! No
wonder you fainted!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of that, I've fallen behind on
everything. I don't have time to gather
funds, so my research budget is virtually
nonexistent...
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! You shouldn't have to bear this
burden alone! We'll help
yoooou!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We'll do whatever it takes to help you
finish your airplaaane!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So, the primary concern now is the lack of
funds. If we don't get
ahead of that issue,
you won't even be able to buy materials.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's work together to gather funds! 
...I think the game's set up so you can
get rewards for completing
tasks for the
townsfolk!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose I can take on tasks that
require mechanical repairs.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then leave deliveries to me!
I'll deliver like there's no tomorrow and
rake in the cash!
And that'll make the folks here in the
city happy too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Hayahide! What about me? Is
there something I can do?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Neither of us have jobs,
so I suppose we can utilize the strengths
we already
have to our advantage. All right, I'll
formulate a plan.
